clauses.unknown: Insufficient completion observation on any material remainder, including lost acknowledgment after possible execution; retain completed parts as evidence.

Transport dispatch, empty local log and discarded context prove neither effect absence nor completion. Never omit irreversible or unintended parts to improve classification.
